title: Hinomori Shiho — Can't Beat That Stare〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Ugh... When I'm in a different place than I'm used to, I just can't quite relax.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I don't think I'll be able to fall asleep, so I'll go get some water or...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh... Sorry, Saki, I didn't mean to—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we were all chatting until just now...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That was already a while ago.
You fell asleep on us, so everyone's sleeping now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! When did I fall asleep?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, did I manage to fall asleep while chatting like it said on my list?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. We were all talking, and then before we knew it you were asleep.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Great...!
Still, I wanted to talk to you guys more...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you want to talk, we can do that tomorrow. Let's just sleep for today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Good...
I thought you'd fallen asleep already.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whaaat, if you fall asleep first I'll be lonely... Don't leave me all alone...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then do your best to fall asleep faster than I do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I always wanted to do the “you still awake?” thing...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean... It's the classic thing you do on school trips or anytime you stay the night as a group, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Right. Saki didn't get to go on the school trip in junior high...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks for doing this sleepover with me, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And for the pictures you surprised me with too! That made me sooo happy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, I can't say it enough!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, alright. If you liked them that much, then I guess it was worth the effort of sneaking those pictures.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I think we're all happy too... Me, Ichika, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That list of things you wanted to do... Those were all things you couldn't do when you were in the hospital, and had to wait for. So...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, you being able to do all the things you wanted to makes us all—

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You were totally asleep just now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We're all so happy that you were able to achieve the things you wanted to do.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (When your album is finished, that'll be the last item on your list done...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Once that happens... It might be nice to celebrate somehow...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'll see what Ichika and the others think tomorrow...)
